definitions.explanation: Suffix attached to a noun to mean the raw material, lumber, or substance used for something. Common in construction, cooking, and manufacturing vocabulary.
By extension, a person regarded as a useful asset or human resource, as in {人|じん}{材|ざい} (human resources) and {逸|いつ}{材|ざい} (an outstanding talent).

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{杉|すぎ}{材|ざい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{建|た}てられている→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
examples.english: This house is built with cedar lumber.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧{材|ざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The price of building materials is rising.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な⟦{食|しょく}{材|ざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦{当社|とうしゃ}→当社：22449_tousha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|じん}{材|ざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{逸|いつ}{材|ざい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれている→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: She is called an exceptional talent even within the industry.

examples.japanese: ⟦グローバル→グローバル：10847_guroobaru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}できる→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧⟦{人|じん}{材|ざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{育成|いくせい}→育成：13928_ikusei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急務|きゅうむ}→急務：21059_kyuumu⟧だ。
examples.english: Developing talent who can thrive globally is an urgent need.

notes:
Suffix derived from {材} (material). Sense 1 (physical material) is concrete and applies to construction, cooking, and manufacturing. Sense 2 (talent) treats people as a resource and is standard in business and HR contexts.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧{材|ざい}: building material
- ⟦{食|しょく}{材|ざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧: food ingredient
- ⟦{木|もく}{材|ざい}→木材：13017_mokuzai⟧: timber; lumber
- ⟦{素|そ}{材|ざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧: raw material; subject matter
- ⟦{教|きょう}{材|ざい}→教材：12878_kyouzai⟧: teaching material
- ⟦{人|じん}{材|ざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧: human resources; talent
- {逸|いつ}{材|ざい}: an outstanding talent
- ⟦{取|しゅ}{材|ざい}→取材：05227_shuzai⟧: news gathering (literally 'taking material')

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧: ingredient; raw material — ⟦{原|げん}{料|りょう}→原料：11802_genryou⟧ raw materials; closer to chemistry/manufacturing
- ⟦{材料|ざいりょう}→材料：02831_zairyou⟧: material; ingredient — stand-alone noun, more general
